mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in FEDFUNDS over the past 6 months signals tightening monetary policy, increasing discount rates on corporate debt and reducing future equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4.5% over the past month signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing corporate investment and consumer spending, which compresses growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross above 4.5% in the past month, or 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) by 5% over the past month signals robust economic growth and reduced inflationary pressures, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase by 5% over the past month
failure_condition: The proxies do not both increase by 5% simultaneously, or 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over the past month signals accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and amplifying equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime is not late-cycle expansion, or 60-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO over the past 3 months signals improving supply chain efficiency, reducing inflationary pressures and boosting investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The INDPRO trend reverses or 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in PAYEMS below 145,000 in the next month signals labor market contraction, reducing corporate investment and consumer spending, which compresses growth and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not fall below 145,000 in the next month, or 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in GDPC1 (demand) and a decline in FEDFUNDS over the past month signals robust demand growth offset by accommodative monetary policy, strengthening equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases by 5% while FEDFUNDS decreases by 1% over the past month
failure_condition: The proxies do not move in the specified direction simultaneously, or 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 250), a sustained increase in INDPRO over the past quarter signals improving supply chain resilience, mitigating inflationary pressures and supporting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime is not high-inflation (CPIAUCSL ≤ 250), or 60-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
